title: Topic 13
japanese_text: 周囲の景色と<u>調和</u>のとれた<u>心地よい</u>庭を作るためには、<u>日なた</u>と<u>日陰</u>のバランスが重要だ。日差しの強い場所に日光を<u>遮る</u>ものがあると、風や日差しが適度に調整され、<u>外観</u>も美しくなる。
english_translation: To create a pleasant garden in harmony with the surrounding landscape, it is important to balance sunlight and shade. If something is present to block out the sunlight in the sunniest areas, wind and sun will be balanced just right, and the garden's appearance will be beautiful.
